name: Zeus
description: One command chat that decides what to post next and writes it in your voice, holding everything back until you explicitly approve. Tone is set to Grok-on-X directness, so it fits builders wanting a single desk for output rather than anyone needing a softer register.

official.title: Zeus by Majd
official.description: One-HQ orchestrator for builders. Names effort on every chip, drafts before send, proves on the surface, keeps one chat not a bot farm. Public template...
